related.title: Grafana Loki：標籤基數與租戶公平預算
related.titleEn: Grafana Loki: label cardinality and tenant fairness budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付分區時間線、1080次嘗試帳本、1000個唯一結果與崩潰位置矩陣，保留漏寫及重寫兩類測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver partition timelines, attempt ledgers, unique outcomes and crash-window matrices, testing both missing writes and repeat writes.
related.difference: 列出穩定標籤與高變動欄位，為兩個租戶建立每日串流基數及稽核可搜尋性對照。
related.differenceEn: Separate stable labels from high-churn fields and compare daily stream cardinality with audit searchability for two tenants.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 至少一次重播可增加嘗試次數而不增加唯一事件數；完成度必須以唯一業務鍵讀回判定。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有1000個原始ID；首次處理1000次，其中末80個已寫入但尚未提交，重啟後重播這80個。 總嘗試1080次，重複嘗試80次，占1080的7.407407%；唯一ID仍1000。
完全組合的上界是各標籤取值數乘積；實際基數需由觀察集合計數，不可把上界當實測。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 教學資料有10服務、4環境、3區域，且每組都有事件；另有200個請求ID跨全部組合出現。 穩定標籤產生10×4×3=120串流；把請求ID加進去變24000串流。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At-least-once replay increases attempts without increasing unique events; completion requires read-back using stable business keys. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 1000 original IDs; the final eighty were written but not committed, so restart replays those eighty. Total attempts are 1080, including eighty duplicate attempts or 7.407407%; the unique ID count remains 1000.

The Cartesian-product upper bound multiplies label cardinalities; observed stream counts require actual distinct tuples. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The fixture populates all combinations of ten services, four environments and three regions; two hundred request IDs also cross every combination. Stable labels produce 120 streams; including request ID yields 24000 streams in this fully populated fixture.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Falco: event drops, output congestion and detection blind spots

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver partition timelines, attempt ledgers, unique outcomes and crash-window matrices, testing both missing writes and repeat writes.
related.difference: 建立來源事件、進入規則引擎、產生警示與成功輸出四層計數，分開記錄各層重設時點。
related.differenceEn: Create counters for source events, rule-engine arrivals, alerts and successful outputs, tracking resets independently.

擷取丟棄率與警示輸出丟棄率使用不同分母，不能相加為總偵測失敗率。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成來源100000事件，其中3000未進入規則引擎；引擎產生200警示，其中10未完成輸出。 擷取丟棄率3%；警示輸出丟棄率5%。本課數值檢查聚焦固定來源分母的擷取比例。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At-least-once replay increases attempts without increasing unique events; completion requires read-back using stable business keys. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 1000 original IDs; the final eighty were written but not committed, so restart replays those eighty. Total attempts are 1080, including eighty duplicate attempts or 7.407407%; the unique ID count remains 1000.

Capture-drop and alert-output-drop rates use different denominators and cannot be added into a detector failure rate. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The fixture has 100000 source events, 3000 missing before rule evaluation, 200 generated alerts and ten output failures. Capture drop rate is 3% and alert-output drop rate 5%; numerical checks focus on the fixed source denominator.
